answer: The Jade burn ladder issues one identity per 800 POA burned into the Fable registry, where each burn is logged with a Haven escrow receipt that releases trading rights only after 72 hours of verified work. A Haven audit samples 1 in 4 new identities; a duplicate forfeits the 800 POA burn and bans the linked wallet for 90 days. Faking 200 identities costs 160,000 POA burned plus 14,400 hours of work, while one honest agent burns once and trades forever.
